title: DiMoP: Diffusion-Driven Motion Representation Learning With Frame-Level Pseudo-Classification for Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
title_zh: DiMoP：面向骨架动作识别的扩散驱动运动表示学习与帧级伪分类

paragraphs.en: Robust skeleton-based action recognition requires representations that capture a wide spectrum of motions, from subtle to moderate and strong ones. Existing methods often focus on strong motions. This paper introduces DiMoP, a masking- and diffusion-driven motion representation learning method with frame-level pseudo-classification to explicitly learn the distribution of joint motions rather than regressing deterministic coordinates, as existing methods often do. By diffusing masked joints with progressive noise and denoising them conditioned on visible joints, DiMoP learns through controllable noising and denoising processes, enabling uniform learning of weak, moderate, and strong dynamics. To enable the masking-based generative diffusion learning with a discriminative capability, a pseudo-frame classifier is proposed that enforces the learning towards sequence-consistent and temporally coherent pseudo-labels without manual annotations. Together, these strategies provide a principled mechanism for joint generative and discriminative motion modeling. DiMoP achieves state-of-the-art performance across NTU RGB+D 60/120, and PKUMMD, including a 1.1 percentage point gain over prior works on NTU RGB+D 120 with the cross-subject protocol. The code is available at DiMoP.
paragraphs.zh: 稳健的基于骨骼的动作识别需要能够捕捉从细微到中等再到强烈动作的广泛运动范围的表示方法。 现有方法通常只关注强烈的动作。 本文提出了 DiMoP，一种基于掩码和扩散的运动表示学习方法，通过帧级伪分类明确学习关节运动的分布，而非像现有方法那样通常回归确定性坐标。 DiMoP 通过对被掩码的关节进行渐进式噪声扩散，并以可见关节为条件对其进行降噪，在可控的加噪与降噪过程中实现学习，从而能够均匀地学习弱、中等和强动态动作。 为了赋予基于掩码的生成式扩散学习方法判别能力，本文提出了一种伪帧分类器，它无需人工标注即可引导模型学习序列一致且时间连贯的伪标签。 这些策略共同构建了一个用于关节生成与判别式运动建模的理论化机制。 DiMoP 在 NTU RGB+D 60/120 和 PKUMMD 数据集上均达到了当前最优性能，其中在采用跨受试者协议的 NTU RGB+D 120 数据集上，其性能较先前工作提升了 1.1 个百分点。 代码可在 DiMoP 获取。

paragraphs.en: Human action recognition is required in many diverse applications, including video surveillance, autonomous driving, robotics, healthcare monitoring, and industrial safety. It enables the detection of hazardous events, abnormal behaviors, and work-efficiency patterns. Compared with RGB-based methods [ 1 , 2 ] , skeleton data, obtainable from CCTV systems or commodity 3D cameras, has emerged as an efficient and robust alternative due to its lower computational cost and reduced sensitivity to environmental variations [ 3 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 人类动作识别在许多不同领域的应用中都是必需的，包括视频监控、自动驾驶、机器人技术、医疗监测和工业安全。 它使得对危险事件、异常行为和工作效率模式的检测成为可能。 与基于 RGB 的方法 [ 1 , 2 ] 相比，可通过闭路电视系统或商用 3D 摄像头获取的骨骼数据，因其计算成本更低且对环境变化的敏感度较低 [ 3 ] ，已成为一种高效且稳健的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: There has been significant progress in supervised action recognition [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] . Despite this progress, performance remains highly dependent on large amounts of annotated training data. Collecting and annotating extensive datasets in the real-world is labor- and time-intensive. Consequently, unsupervised and self-supervised methods have emerged as promising alternatives [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 监督式动作识别领域取得了显著进展 [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] 。 尽管取得了这些进展，其性能仍然高度依赖大量标注好的训练数据。 在真实世界中收集并标注大规模数据集需要耗费大量人力和时间。 因此，无监督和自我监督方法已成为有前景的替代方案 [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In self-supervised learning (SSL), learned representations are required to capture the intrinsic structure and distribution of the data without annotations to enhance downstream performance. To this end, various pre-training approaches are employed to learn effective representations. These approaches can be broadly categorized into two groups: contrastive methods [ 13 , 14 , 10 , 16 ] and generative methods [ 12 , 17 , 18 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在自监督学习（SSL）中，所学习的表示需要捕捉数据的内在结构和分布，而无需标注，从而提升下游任务的性能。 为此，人们采用了多种预训练方法来学习有效的表示。 这些方法可以大致分为两类：对比方法 [ 13 , 14 , 10 , 16 ] 和生成方法 [ 12 , 17 , 18 ] 。

sents.zh: 在自监督学习（SSL）中，所学习的表示需要捕捉数据的内在结构和分布，而无需标注，从而提升下游任务的性能。

sents.zh: 这些方法可以大致分为两类：对比方法 [ 13 , 14 , 10 , 16 ] 和生成方法 [ 12 , 17 , 18 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Contrastive approaches employ various transformations to approximate the data distribution in the real world. Typically, handcrafted transformations, such as random cropping, scaling, rotations, and temporal jittering, are used to generate multiple views of the same instance, thereby enhancing data diversity [ 14 , 16 ] . However, these operations provide only limited stochasticity and fail to simulate the true probabilistic distribution of motion dynamics, ultimately oversimplifying the complex and uncertain behaviors inherent in skeletal movements, particularly the subtle movements.
paragraphs.zh: 对比方法采用各种变换来近似真实世界中的数据分布。 通常，手工设计的变换（如随机裁剪、缩放、旋转和时间抖动）被用来生成同一实例的多个视图，从而增强数据多样性 [ 14 , 16 ] 。 然而，这些操作仅提供有限的随机性，无法模拟运动动态的真实概率分布，最终过度简化了骨骼运动中固有的复杂且不确定的行为，尤其是细微的动作。

paragraphs.en: Recent generative methods typically adopt the Masked Autoencoder (MAE) [ 19 ] framework for representation learning by reconstructing masked joints or body parts from unmasked or visible joints [ 12 , 17 , 18 ] . In these methods, random [ 11 , 12 ] or sample-dependent masking [ 17 ] is often used. Although this design effectively models the relationship between unmasked and masked parts and captures their dynamics, the direct prediction of masked joints from unmasked joints often fails to learn subtle dynamics due to the simultaneous coexistence of weak and strong dynamics , leading to ineffective modeling of subtle motion in the presence of highly complex and dynamic motion patterns in the real world and, hence, compromising the generalization of the learned representations.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的生成方法通常采用掩码自编码器（MAE）[ 19 ]框架进行表示学习，即通过从未掩码或可见的关节中重建被掩码的关节或身体部位 [ 12 , 17 , 18 ]。 在这些方法中，通常会使用随机 [ 11 , 12 ] 或依赖样本的掩码方式 [ 17 ]。 尽管这种设计能有效建模未掩码部分与掩码部分之间的关系并捕捉其动态变化，但直接从未掩码关节预测被掩码关节的做法往往无法学习到细微的动态特征，这是因为弱动态与强动态同时存在，导致在真实世界中高度复杂且动态的运动模式下，细微运动难以被有效建模，从而削弱了所学表示的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: To improve the learning of subtle motion and the discriminative power of the learned representation, this paper proposes a framework for Di ffusion-Driven Mo tion Representation Learning with Frame-Level P seudo-classification, referred to as DiMoP. DiMoP is a joint diffusion-based generative and unsupervised discriminative learning model. First, DiMoP randomly selects joints and gradually diffuses them with controlled Gaussian noise, followed by denoising conditioned on the representation of visible joints. This progressive diffusion trajectory compels the model to learn subtle motion variations in the early steps and high-energy dynamics in the later steps, providing a principled mechanism that treats all motion scales equally: subtle, moderate, and strong. Second, a frame-based pseudo-classification module is introduced to enhance the discriminativeness of the learned motion representation. The pseudo-classification module transforms a sequence of uniformly distributed random numbers of the same length as the action sequence into a frame-based pseudo-action label, conditioned upon the learned motion representation of the unmasked joints or parts. Note that we refer to the module as a pseudo-frame-based classifier or a pseudo-classifier because the actual action label is unknown, and the classifier aims to enforce the learned representation to achieve consistent and temporally coherent frame-based labels for the entire sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 为了提升对细微动作的学习能力以及所学表示的区分能力，本文提出了一种基于扩散驱动的动作表示学习框架，并引入帧级伪分类机制，简称为 DiMoP。 DiMoP 是一种联合的、基于扩散的生成模型与无监督判别学习模型。 首先，DiMoP 会随机选择关节，并通过受控的高斯噪声对其逐步进行扩散，随后以可见关节的表示为条件执行去噪操作。 这种渐进式的扩散轨迹迫使模型在早期步骤中学习细微的动作变化，并在后期步骤中捕捉高能量动态，从而提供了一种能够平等对待所有动作尺度（细微、中等和强烈）的理论化机制。 其次，本文引入了一种基于帧的伪分类模块，以增强所学动作表示的区分能力。 该伪分类模块将一组与动作序列长度相同、均匀分布的随机数序列，转换为基于帧的伪动作标签，其生成以未遮蔽关节或部分的所学动作表示为条件。 需要注意的是，我们之所以将该模块称为伪帧级分类器或伪分类器，是因为实际的动作标签是未知的，而该分类器的目标是迫使所学表示能够为整个序列生成一致且具有时间连贯性的帧级标签。

DiMoP replaces deterministic masking with a progressive noise–denoise process, enabling the model to fully capture the joint motion distribution and effectively learn the subtle, moderate, and strong dynamics. paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments were conducted on four benchmark datasets to demonstrate that the proposed generative–discriminative design consistently yields state-of-the-art or competitive performance, thereby validating its effectiveness for skeleton representation learning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在四个基准数据集上进行了大量实验，结果表明，所提出的生成-判别式设计始终能够取得当前最优或具有竞争力的性能，从而验证了其在骨骼表示学习中的有效性。

paragraphs.en: This section briefly reviews recent advances in supervised and self-supervised skeleton-based action recognition.
paragraphs.zh: 本节简要回顾了基于骨骼的有监督与自监督动作识别领域的最新进展。

paragraphs.en: In early-stage works, CNN [ 20 , 21 , 22 ] and RNN [ 23 , 24 ] architectures were often employed for action recognition, while more recent studies have been dominated by GCN [ 4 , 25 , 7 , 6 ] and transformer-based architectures [ 26 , 8 ] due to their promising performance.
paragraphs.zh: 在早期研究中，CNN [ 20 , 21 , 22 ] 和 RNN [ 23 , 24 ] 架构常被用于动作识别，而近期的研究则主要采用 GCN [ 4 , 25 , 7 , 6 ] 和基于 transformer 的架构 [ 26 , 8 ]，因为它们在性能上展现出巨大潜力。

paragraphs.en: Graph convolutional networks (GCNs) for skeleton-based action recognition were introduced by Yan et al. in the ST-GCN framework [ 27 ] . Subsequently, various techniques have been explored to improve model accuracy and robustness, including the use of adaptive data-driven topologies [ 4 , 28 ] , the expansion of spatial and temporal receptive fields [ 29 , 30 ] , adaptive feature aggregation [ 5 , 6 , 31 ] , and prompt-based learning strategies [ 32 ] .
paragraphs.zh: Yan 等人在 ST-GCN 框架中引入了基于骨骼的动作识别的图卷积网络（GCNs）[ 27 ]。 随后，为了提升模型精度和鲁棒性，研究者探索了多种技术，包括使用自适应数据驱动拓扑结构 [ 4 , 28 ]、扩展空间和时间感受野 [ 29 , 30 ]、自适应特征聚合 [ 5 , 6 , 31 ] 以及提示 기반 学习策略 [ 32 ]。

paragraphs.en: In ST-TR [ 33 ] , vision transformers are employed for skeleton action recognition through the introduction of distinct spatial and temporal attention modules. Subsequent works have explored hybrid transformers by integrating transformers with GCNs [ 34 , 35 ] or temporal convolutions [ 36 ] , along with attention modules and developing parameter-efficient models [ 26 ] . Recent studies have demonstrated that mask modeling is an effective approach for training vanilla transformer networks. The proposed DiMoP adapts a vanilla ViT [ 37 ] as the encoder and extends transformers to function as both the denoising decoder and the pseudo-frame-based classifier.

paragraphs.en: Recent self-supervised approaches have employed contrastive [ 13 , 14 , 38 , 10 ] and generative methods [ 11 , 12 , 18 , 39 ] to learn meaningful representations from unlabeled data, thereby improving performance in multiple downstream tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的自监督方法已采用对比学习 [ 13 , 14 , 38 , 10 ] 和生成方法 [ 11 , 12 , 18 , 39 ]，从无标签数据中学习有意义的表示，从而提升了多个下游任务的性能。

paragraphs.en: In contrastive learning, representations are learned by distinguishing between positive and negative pairs, which are typically generated using transformation functions that enhance the diversity of training samples. For instance, SkeletonCLR [ 38 ] employs shear and crop transformations. Recent studies demonstrate that stronger transformations, those that incorporate rich semantic information, can significantly improve generalizability and reduce the gap with fully supervised methods. Building on this idea, AimCLR [ 14 ] introduces extreme transformations to generate novel movement patterns, employing four spatial transformations (shear, spatial flip, rotation, axis mask), two temporal transformations (crop, temporal flip), and two spatio-temporal transformations (Gaussian noise, Gaussian blur). In contrast, ActCLR [ 13 ] applies extreme transformations only to static body parts to preserve critical motion-related information. Despite the introduction of various data transformations, many fail to effectively simulate the complex motion dynamics, limiting their ability to capture the full range of movement variations.
paragraphs.zh: 在对比学习中，智能体通过区分正负样本对来学习表示，而这些样本对通常由能够增强训练样本多样性的变换函数生成。 例如，SkeletonCLR [ 38 ] 使用了剪切和裁剪变换。 近期研究表明，更强的变换——即包含丰富语义信息的变换——可以显著提升泛化能力，并缩小与完全监督方法之间的差距。 基于这一理念，AimCLR [ 14 ] 引入了极端变换来生成新的运动模式，具体采用了四种空间变换（剪切、空间翻转、旋转、轴掩码）、两种时间变换（裁剪、时间翻转）以及两种时空变换（高斯噪声、高斯模糊）。 相比之下，ActCLR [ 13 ] 仅对静态身体部位应用极端变换，以保留关键的与运动相关的信息。 尽管引入了多种数据变换，但许多方法仍未能有效模拟复杂的运动动态，从而限制了它们捕捉完整运动变化的能力。

paragraphs.en: Masked Autoencoders (MAEs) [ 19 ] have recently been actively adopted in 3D action representation learning. Transformer-based MAEs were reported in SkeletonMAE [ 12 ] to reconstruct randomly masked joints. Specifically, visible joints are mapped to latent representations by the encoder, after which masked joints are replaced with fixed embeddings referred to as learnable tokens. These tokens, along with the latent representations of visible joints, are then fed into the reconstruction decoder to recover the masked joint coordinates. Subsequent works explored different masking operations or reconstruction targets to improve representation learning. For instance, in MAMP [ 17 ] , highly mobile joints were masked with a higher probability, and the original motion was reconstructed starting from learnable tokens. However, because every masked joint is represented by the same learnable token, the model’s ability to capture the variability inherent in human motion is limited. In contrast, in DiMoP, diffused joints are used to replace the conventional masked patches, thereby encouraging the network to learn a probabilistic mapping from noisy to clean joint configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 掩码自编码器（MAEs）[ 19 ] 最近已被积极应用于三维动作表示学习。 SkeletonMAE [ 12 ] 报告了基于 Transformer 的 MAE 能够重构随机掩码的关节。 具体而言，编码器将可见关节映射为潜在表示，随后用称为可学习标记的固定嵌入替换被掩码的关节。 这些标记与可见关节的潜在表示一起被输入到重构解码器中，以恢复被掩码的关节坐标。 后续研究探索了不同的掩码操作或重构目标，以提升表示学习效果。 例如，在 MAMP [ 17 ] 中，高移动性关节以更高的概率被掩码，并基于可学习标记重构原始动作。 然而，由于每个被掩码的关节都由相同的可学习标记表示，模型捕捉人类动作固有变异性能力受到限制。 相比之下，DiMoP 使用扩散关节替代传统的掩码区域，从而促使网络学习从噪声关节配置到干净关节配置的概率性映射。

paragraphs.en: Recently proposed MacDiff [ 11 ] employs a masked conditional diffusion framework where the denoiser is conditioned via global Adaptive Layer Normalization (AdaLN). The global representation, obtained by pooling the local features of visible joints from the semantic encoder, is used to uniformly scale and shift all feature channels in each denoiser layer. This global conditioning drives the denoising of the entire diffused skeleton, updating both visible and masked joints under the same modulation. Such global feature modulation provides coarse, sequence-level conditioning but lacks joint- or spatial-specific distinction. In contrast, DiMoP introduces a structured partial-state diffusion that diffuses only masked joints while keeping visible joints as clean anchors throughout the denoising. Instead of global AdaLN modulation, DiMoP performs token-level cross-conditioning via cross-attention; queries from noisy (masked) joints attend to keys/values from visible-joint embeddings, enabling localized, motion-aware guidance that MacDiff’s global feature modulation cannot achieve.
paragraphs.zh: 最近提出的 MacDiff [ 11 ] 采用了一种掩码条件扩散框架，其中去噪器通过全局自适应层归一化（AdaLN）进行条件约束。 该全局表示由语义编码器中可见关节的局部特征池化得到，用于对每层去噪器中的所有特征通道进行统一缩放和偏移。 这种全局条件约束驱动整个扩散骨骼的去噪过程，在相同的调制下同时更新可见关节和掩码关节。 这种全局特征调制提供了粗略的序列级条件约束，但缺乏针对特定关节或空间位置的区分能力。 相比之下，DiMoP 引入了一种结构化部分状态扩散方法，仅对掩码关节进行扩散，同时在去噪过程中始终保留可见关节作为干净的锚点。 DiMoP 没有采用全局 AdaLN 调制，而是通过交叉注意力实现令牌级的跨条件约束：来自噪声（掩码）关节的查询会关注来自可见关节嵌入的键/值，从而实现 MacDiff 的全局特征调制无法达到的局部化、运动感知的引导。

paragraphs.en: Three decoder configurations are examined, differing in how attention is applied between visible latents and noisy tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了三种解码器配置，这些配置在可见潜在变量与噪声标记之间注意力机制的应用方式上有所不同。

paragraphs.en: Joint Decoder: This configuration takes the full set of tokens (joints), τ × V \tau\times V , as input, which consists of (i) encoded visible joints and (ii) diffused mask joints placed at their corresponding indices (visible indices i ​ d ​ x v ​ i ​ s ​ i ​ b ​ l ​ e idx_{visible} and mask indices i ​ d ​ x m ​ a ​ s ​ k idx_{mask} ). Queries, keys, and values are obtained through linear projections of this combined token set. However, by mixing visible and masked joints without explicit separation, there is a risk of interference between the clean conditional data and the noisy inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 联合解码器：这种配置以完整的标记集合（联合）τ × V \tau\times V 作为输入，该集合包含（i）编码后的可见关节和（ii）放置在其对应索引处的扩散掩码关节（可见索引 idx_{visible} 和掩码索引 idx_{mask}）。 查询、键和值是通过对该联合标记集合进行线性投影获得的。 然而，由于在未经明确分离的情况下混合了可见关节和掩码关节，因此存在干净的条件数据与噪声输入之间相互干扰的风险。

paragraphs.en: Cross Decoder V1: In this variant, each decoder block employs a cross-attention layer where noisy joints first attend to the latent representation of visible joints. Specifically, queries are computed through a linear projection of the noisy joints, while keys and values are derived solely from the linear projections of the latent visible joints. This iterative process denoises each noise patch conditioned on the constant visible information. One drawback is that each noisy joint attends independently to the visible joints, without considering the interactions among other noisy joints.
paragraphs.zh: Cross Decoder V1：在此变体中，每个解码器模块都使用一个交叉注意力层，其中噪声关节首先关注可见关节的潜在表示。 具体而言，查询通过噪声关节的线性投影计算得出，而键和值则完全来自可见关节潜在表示的线性投影。 这一迭代过程以恒定的可见信息为条件，对每个噪声区域进行去噪处理。 其中一个缺点是，每个噪声关节都独立地关注可见关节，而未考虑其他噪声关节之间的相互作用。

paragraphs.en: The pseudo-frame classifier serves as an auxiliary head that imposes a frame-level discriminative constraint. In particular, the pseudo-classifier enforces temporal coherence by mapping all frames of a sequence toward a consistent label space, thereby suppressing frame-level noise and compacting sequence-level representations. Although not tied to true action labels, these homogeneous pseudo-labels act as latent surrogates that enhance feature separability and strengthen discriminative power for downstream recognition.
paragraphs.zh: 伪帧分类器作为一个辅助头，施加了帧级别的判别性约束。 具体而言，伪分类器通过将序列中的所有帧映射到一个一致的标签空间来确保时间一致性，从而抑制帧级噪声并压缩序列级表示。 尽管这些伪标签并未与真实的动作标签绑定，但它们作为潜在的替代标签，能够提升特征的可分离性，并增强下游识别任务的判别能力。

paragraphs.en: While diffusion learning primarily reconstructs motion dynamics, it may yield overly smooth representations; the pseudo-classifier mitigates this by enforcing temporal consistency within actions and separation across distinct motion phases, effectively introducing an implicit temporal clustering signal that enhances inter-class separability and intra-action coherence without real labels. paragraphs.en: The proposed DiMoP is evaluated on three commonly used large-scale datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 所提出的 DiMoP 在三个常用的大规模数据集上进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: NTU RGB+D 60 is a large-scale dataset for human action recognition that contains 60 action categories performed by 40 subjects, totaling 56,880 skeleton sequences. The dataset is evaluated using two standard protocols: cross-subject (X-Sub) and cross-view (X-View). In the X-Sub protocol, action sequences from 20 subjects are used for training, while sequences from the remaining subjects are reserved for testing. paragraphs.en: These datasets provide complementary evaluation settings with distinct degradation factors and purposes. NTU RGB+D 60 serves as a standard benchmark for comparison with existing self-supervised skeleton representation learning methods, covering viewpoint changes, inter-subject variation, intra-class diversity, and skeleton tracking noise. NTU RGB+D 120 evaluates scalability and robustness in a larger and more diverse setting, with 120 action classes, 106 subjects from 15 countries, wide age and height ranges, multiple camera setups, fine-grained actions, object interactions, and diverse skeleton variations. PKUMMD assesses generalization under more realistic sequence-level challenges, including long continuous actions, action transitions, temporal ambiguity, subject overlap, and occlusion. Collectively, these datasets evaluate DiMoP across standard benchmark comparison, large-scale recognition, and challenging settings, while covering action classes with subtle, strong, and mixed subtle–strong motion patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 这些数据集提供了互补的评估设置，具有不同的退化因素和用途。 NTU RGB+D 60 作为与现有自监督骨骼表示学习方法进行比较的标准基准，涵盖了视角变化、个体间差异、类内多样性以及骨骼跟踪噪声等问题。 NTU RGB+D 120 在一个更大且更具多样性的环境中评估可扩展性和鲁棒性，包含 120 个动作类别、来自 15 个国家的 106 名受试者、广泛的年龄和身高范围、多种摄像头设置、精细动作、物体交互以及多样化的骨骼变化。 PKUMMD 评估了在更真实的序列级挑战下的泛化能力，包括长时间连续动作、动作转换、时间模糊性、受试者重叠以及遮挡等问题。 总体而言，这些数据集从标准基准比较、大规模识别和具有挑战性的设置等多个角度对 DiMoP 进行了评估，同时涵盖了具有细微、强烈以及混合的细微-强烈运动模式的动作类别。

paragraphs.en: Table V compares simple random masking with motion-aware random masking, implemented following [ 17 ] . Random masking achieves better performance because it uniformly exposes all joints to the denoising objective, whereas motion-aware masking may over-emphasize large-motion joints and under-sample subtle yet discriminative motions. Nevertheless, uniform masking is not intended to explicitly model structured occlusion. In scenarios with persistent joint occlusion, such as lower-body occlusion behind a desk, joint-confidence scores from the pose estimator could be incorporated into both the masking probabilities and denoising loss to avoid treating unreliable or unavailable joints as reconstruction targets. Table VI further shows that a high masking ratio of 90% yields the best performance.
paragraphs.zh: 表 V 比较了简单的随机掩码与遵循 [ 17 ] 方法实现的运动感知随机掩码。 随机掩码能取得更好的性能，因为它将所有关节均匀地暴露于去噪目标中，而运动感知掩码可能会过度强调大运动幅度的关节，并欠采样那些细微但具有区分性的运动。 然而，均匀掩码并非旨在显式地建模结构化遮挡。 在存在持续关节遮挡的场景中（例如身体下半身被桌子遮挡的情况），可以将姿态估计器输出的关节置信度分数同时整合到掩码概率和去噪损失中，以避免将不可靠或不可用的关节视为重建目标。 表 VI 进一步表明，90% 的高掩码比率能带来最佳性能。

paragraphs.en: As shown, substantial improvements were observed for the majority of actions. Performance declines were noted for some actions, many of which involve interactions between two subjects. Actions in which the discriminative cue is subtle and short-lived, while most frames are dominated by neutral or overlapping poses, remain challenging. In these cases, sequence-level homogeneity tends to overshadow the brief but critical cues, resulting in misclassifications and reduced accuracy. These results underscore the effectiveness of DiMoP in modeling the distribution of joint dynamics.

paragraphs.en: To provide a more fine-grained analysis, the 60 action classes are grouped according to their motion characteristics: fine-grained single-person actions (G1), large body-motion actions (G2), hand-object interactions (G3), two-person interactions (G4) and weak-discriminative-frame actions (G5). As summarized in Table XII , DiMoP improves 47 out of 60 classes, corresponding to 78.3% of the actions, with an average gain of 1.90 percentage points over MAMP. Consistent improvements are observed across all groups, particularly for large body-motion actions and two-person interactions, where 91.7% and 90.9% of the classes are improved, respectively. These results indicate that progressive denoising facilitates the learning of both localized motion patterns and interaction-related dynamics. The relatively lower improvement ratios in hand-object and weak-discriminative-frame actions suggest that skeleton-only representations remain limited when object contact cues or short-lived discriminative frames are critical.

paragraphs.en: A diffusion-based framework, DiMoP, was introduced for skeleton representation learning to model motion dynamics by progressively adding noise and denoising skeleton joints. By replacing static masking and handcrafted transformations with a stochastic, iterative denoising process, DiMoP effectively captures the uncertainty inherent in skeletal motion and enhances generalization. In addition, a pseudo-frame-based classifier was proposed to inject a discriminative structure without requiring manual labels. The proposed method achieved state-of-the-art performance on three standard benchmarks in action classification.
paragraphs.zh: 一种基于扩散的框架 DiMoP 被引入到骨骼表示学习中，通过逐步添加噪声和去噪骨骼关节来建模运动动态。 通过将静态掩码和人工设计的变换替换为随机、迭代式的去噪过程，DiMoP 有效捕捉了骨骼运动中固有的不确定性，并提升了泛化能力。 此外，研究还提出了一种基于伪帧的分类器，无需手动标注即可注入判别性结构。 该方法在三个标准动作分类基准测试中达到了当前最优性能。

paragraphs.en: However, DiMoP might be limited when discriminative cues are brief, highly localized, or dependent on object/contact information. For instance, actions such as headache and neck pain share similar hand-to-head/neck movements, where only a few frames carry discriminative evidence. The pseudo-frame classifier promotes sequence-level temporal consistency, which stabilizes representations but may suppress such short-lived cues. Moreover, object-centric actions such as wearing shoes , typing on a keyboard , or playing with a phone may remain challenging because skeleton-only input does not explicitly encode object appearance or precise hand-object contact. It should be noted that these issues are not unique to DiMoP; they also exist in existing methods such as MAMP and MacDiff.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，当区分性线索短暂、高度局部化或依赖于物体/接触信息时，DiMoP 可能会受到限制。 例如，头痛和颈部疼痛等动作具有相似的手部对头部/颈部的运动，而其中只有少数帧包含区分性证据。 伪帧分类器促进了序列级的时间一致性，这虽然能稳定表示，但可能会抑制此类短暂出现的线索。 此外，以物体为中心的动作（如穿鞋、在键盘上打字或玩手机）可能仍然具有挑战性，因为仅基于骨骼的输入并未明确编码物体的外观或精确的手-物体接触信息。 需要注意的是，这些问题并非 DiMoP 所独有；MAMP 和 MacDiff 等现有方法也存在类似的问题。

paragraphs.en: Future work will explore motion-adaptive diffusion scheduling and interaction between subjects. For instance, subtle moving joints will receive less noise or undergo slower denoising, while highly moving joints will retain full diffusion depth. This direction is expected to further improve the model’s ability to distinguish between complex and diverse motion patterns in real-world scenarios.

paragraphs.en: To further verify the source of DiMoP’s improvement, MacDiff’s [ 11 ] AdaLN-based conditional U-Net decoder was substituted into DiMoP while keeping the encoder, noise schedule, and training settings identical ( T = 300 T=300 , linear schedule). paragraphs.en: Table XVIII provides a group-level interpretation of the class-wise results. The larger gain on subtle-motion actions suggests that DiMoP better preserves localized, low-amplitude cues that are easily dominated by stronger body movements in direct masked reconstruction. This indicates a key limitation of MAE-style objectives: reconstruction can be biased toward high-energy motion components, whereas progressive denoising exposes the model to fine deviations around the clean motion manifold at high-SNR stages. The gain on strong-motion actions further shows that DiMoP does not improve subtle actions at the expense of large-scale dynamics, but also retains global displacement, posture transitions, and interaction patterns through later denoising stages. Therefore, the observed improvements are not merely class-wise fluctuations; they indicate that DiMoP learns motion representations across multiple spatial and temporal scales.
paragraphs.zh: 表 XVIII 对各类别结果提供了群体层面的解释。 在细微动作上的更大提升表明，DiMoP 能更好地保留局部化、低振幅的线索，而这些线索在直接掩码重建中容易被更强烈的身体动作所掩盖。 这表明 MAE 风格目标函数的一个关键局限性：重建过程可能偏向于高能量运动成分，而渐进式去噪则会在高信噪比阶段让模型接触到干净运动流形周围的细微偏差。 在强烈动作上的提升进一步表明，DiMoP 并未以牺牲大规模动态为代价来改善细微动作，而是通过后续的去噪阶段保留了全局位移、姿态转换和交互模式。 因此，观察到的改进并非仅仅是类别间的波动；它们表明 DiMoP 能够在多个空间和时间尺度上学习运动表示。

paragraphs.en: To further examine whether the improvements are biased toward high-motion classes, class-wise motion magnitude was computed as the average frame-wise joint displacement normalized by body size. The body size was estimated using the spine-to-neck bone length, which provides a stable torso-based scale factor and reduces the influence of inter-subject size variation. Fig. 6 plots the normalized motion magnitude against the relative percentage improvement of DiMoP over MAMP.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步探究这些改进是否偏向于高运动类别，我们按类别计算了运动幅度，即每帧关节位移的平均值，并经过身体尺寸归一化处理。 身体尺寸通过脊柱到颈部的骨骼长度进行估算，这提供了一个基于躯干的稳定比例因子，并减少了个体间尺寸差异的影响。 图6展示了归一化后的运动幅度与 DiMoP 相对于 MAMP 的相对百分比改进值之间的关系。

paragraphs.en: The scatter distribution shows that DiMoP improves classes across a broad range of normalized motion magnitudes, including several low-motion subtle actions. paragraphs.en: As shown in Table XIX , positive average gains were obtained across all motion groups, indicating that the improvements were not restricted to isolated classes. paragraphs.en: As shown in Table XX , increasing λ \lambda without ℒ c ​ o ​ n ​ s ​ i ​ s ​ t ​ e ​ n ​ c ​ y \mathcal{L}_{consistency} does not recover the performance of the full objective. Instead, large λ \lambda values progressively degrade accuracy, indicating that excessive temporal smoothing over-regularizes the pseudo-classifier and weakens representation learning. This confirms that ℒ s ​ m ​ o ​ o ​ t ​ h \mathcal{L}_{smooth} and ℒ c ​ o ​ n ​ s ​ i ​ s ​ t ​ e ​ n ​ c ​ y \mathcal{L}_{consistency} are complementary: ℒ s ​ m ​ o ​ o ​ t ​ h \mathcal{L}_{smooth} regularizes local frame-to-frame transitions, whereas ℒ c ​ o ​ n ​ s ​ i ​ s ​ t ​ e ​ n ​ c ​ y \mathcal{L}_{consistency} imposes global sequence-level agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 XX 所示，在不具备 ℒ c ​ o ​ n ​ s ​ i ​ s ​ t ​ e ​ n ​ c ​ y \mathcal{L}_{consistency} 的情况下增加 λ \lambda，并不能恢复完整目标函数的性能。 相反，较大的 λ \lambda 值会逐渐降低准确性，这表明过度的时间平滑会对伪分类器造成过强的正则化效应，并削弱表示学习的能力。 这证实了 ℒ s ​ m ​ o ​ o ​ t ​ h \mathcal{L}_{smooth} 和 ℒ c ​ o ​ n ​ s ​ i ​ s ​ t ​ e ​ n ​ c ​ y \mathcal{L}_{consistency} 是互补的：ℒ s ​ m ​ o ​ o ​ t ​ h \mathcal{L}_{smooth} 对局部帧间过渡进行正则化，而 ℒ c ​ o ​ n ​ s ​ i ​ s ​ t ​ e ​ n ​ c ​ y \mathcal{L}_{consistency} 则施加全局序列级别的约束。
